# PyVideo.org

> > A volunteer-driven archive of Python conference talks, meetup presentations, and community videos organized by speakers, topics, and tags.

PyVideo.org is a community-maintained repository of Python video content from major conferences like PyCon FR, PyCon, and local meetups. The site provides comprehensive browsing and discovery tools for developers seeking talks on Python topics, frameworks, and best practices.

## Key Topics

- Python
- Conference talks
- PyCon FR 2025
- Meetup Paris
- ORM
- SQLAlchemy
- GeoPandas
- Decorators
- Metaclasses
- Community
- Volunteer-driven
- Video archive
- Speaker directory
- Tag-based browsing
- AFPY

## Core Navigation

- [About PyVideo.org](https://pyvideo.org/pages/about.html): About PyVideo.org: volunteer-driven Python media archive
- [Browse by Tags](https://pyvideo.org/tags.html): Tag index for browsing Python videos by topic classification
- [Speaker Directory](https://pyvideo.org/speakers.html): Directory of Python conference speakers in PyVideo.org database

## Conference Talks

- [À la sauce Python: Metaclasses, Decorators, and ORM](https://pyvideo.org/pycon-fr-2025/a-la-sauce-python-metaclasses-decorateurs-et-orm-fait-maison.html): PyCon FR 2025 talk on Python metaclasses, decorators, and ORM
- [Advanced Alchemy: Powerful SQLAlchemy Wrapper](https://pyvideo.org/pycon-fr-2025/advanced-alchemy-surcouche-puissante-de-sqlalchemy.html): PyCon FR 2025 talk on Advanced Alchemy SQLAlchemy wrapper
- [Application Auditing and Code Quality](https://pyvideo.org/pycon-fr-2025/au-secours-on-vient-auditer-mon-application.html): PyCon FR 2025 talk on application auditing and code quality

## Meetup Presentations

- [Geographic Data Manipulation with GeoPandas](https://pyvideo.org/meetup-paris/manipuler-la-donnee-geographique-en-python-avec-geopandas.html): GeoPandas talk on geographic data manipulation from Meetup Paris
- [Odoo: Discovery and Dependency Engine Focus](https://pyvideo.org/meetup-paris/odoo-decouverte-et-focus-sur-le-moteur-de-dependances-apidepends.html): Odoo dependency engine talk from Paris Meetup in French
